verdict.rationale: Chroma is an API-first database. A published OpenAPI spec exists, and the docs show core operations done programmatically: adding data with automatic embedding and indexing, `.query`, and `.get` with metadata and document filtering. A CLI and an MCP server add further programmatic access. However, nothing in the evidence states or shows that every Chroma Cloud UI action has an API equivalent. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API coverage of Cloud dashboard functions (e.g. forking, billing and account management), and independent corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
